6.why: Neutral informative register; A is stilted, B/D too casual

8.why: No context; 'As a result' is a common causal fix for a mechanical sequence of a boat leaning

9.why: Introductory dependent clause takes a comma; A/C create a fragment, B misplaces the comma

10.why: Most concise correct combination; A redundant, D comma splice

11.why: Singular subject 'row' in present tense takes 'gives off'

12.why: 'together' and 'all at the same moment' redundant with 'groups' and 'in unison'; A loses needed meaning

13.why: Bias from unequal reachability distorts in either direction; 'skews' fits, inflates/dampens are one-directional

14.why: Aching shoulders plausibly motivate training a successor (cause); Although is possible contrast

15.why: 'reverses the order' is the precise physical sense; others are legal/argumentative senses
